algorithm.scale_solver: exact Fraction assignment breakpoints; clipped quadratic B/A on each interval

units_and_scope.mse: Original q integer-coordinate squared error. Original W0 is the reference, MSE 0.
units_and_scope.entropy: Seven supported code masses, global and count-weighted per-tensor separately.
units_and_scope.c3: Existing static15: 15 positive frequencies total4096, one reserve each, 4081 proportional; expected data bits plus nominal 28 B per tensor.
units_and_scope.predicted_W: Existing actual static15 W0 plus difference of expected INT4+table bytes. Metadata compression, BF16-scale byte entropy and final range rounding remain unmeasured.
units_and_scope.physical_error_formula_before_BF16_round: For row j in tensor t, physical_SSE_tj = original_signed_BF16_scale_tj**2 * SSE_q_tj before new BF16 rounding; tensor/overall physical error requires rowwise errors and original scales, while this census aggregates q counts per tensor.
units_and_scope.future_native_scale_contract: Keep the sign of original BF16 scale and multiply by the fitted positive ratio once; real BF16 RNE and exported native identity belong to a future full-method admission.
